programName: Grundlärarprogrammet med inriktning mot arbete i fritidshem
notes: HT26 education plan has multiple programme entries/specialisations, including home and consumer studies, physical education, music and art, plus variants for students with professional experience. The public plan confirms the programme-level credit distribution but not one universal term-by-term sequence across all specialisations.
The 15 hp thesis is included within the 60 hp subject-studies block and is therefore stored as a non-additive nested component to prevent double counting.
